principles: Uses repository-local docs and generated records as source evidence.
Keeps planned, blocked, active, and validated states visible.
Does not perform external API, SSH, deployment, release, or destructive actions.
Routes users to real local surfaces instead of fake controls.

summary.title: SEIS Command Center
summary.subtitle: Non-LLM operating shell for the SEIS ecosystem foundation.
summary.nextSafeAction: Resolve repository hygiene and governance source-of-truth blockers before public, release, deployment, or live integration claims.

modules.title: Goal Tracking Center
modules.description: Generated non-LLM view for goals, blockers, evidence, reviews, planning horizons, progress ledger, objective coverage, and completion gates.
modules.nextAction: Keep generated records fresh and wire deeper shell routing only after repository hygiene is isolated.

modules.title: Repository Hygiene
modules.description: Tracks unresolved deletions, missing governance docs, missing validators, and nested snapshot risks.
modules.nextAction: Restore, replace, or explicitly approve removal of missing governance files in a focused recovery PR.

modules.title: Roadmap Center
modules.description: Consolidated backlog and next PR queue for safe foundation sequencing.
modules.nextAction: Keep PR 1 focused on foundation recovery before routed shell expansion or readiness claims.

modules.title: Evidence Locker
modules.description: Structured proof, blocker, validation, security-scan, commit, and review records for Goal Tracking OS.
modules.nextAction: Keep evidence scoped, current, limitation-aware, and free of private paths or secrets.

modules.title: Approval Center
modules.description: Human approval rules for dangerous actions, external access, cleanup, deployment, SSH, release, and model operations.
modules.nextAction: Keep dangerous actions documented and approval-gated; do not turn planned approvals into live controls.

modules.title: Release And Public Readiness
modules.description: Release and public-readiness dry-run framework, currently blocked by repository hygiene and validation recovery.
modules.nextAction: Run readiness dry-runs only after foundation validation is recoverable.

modules.title: AI Core Foundation
modules.description: Provider-neutral AI Core direction for model router, prompt engine, agent runtime, evaluation, and SEIS Universe research without model ownership overclaims.
modules.nextAction: Add AI Core contracts only after repository hygiene blockers are isolated.

modules.title: Documentation Hub
modules.description: Navigation spine for source-of-truth docs, status, roadmap, reviews, goals, architecture, governance, and evidence.
modules.nextAction: Keep index, status, backlog, and review docs synchronized after each foundation slice.

guardrails.title: No Fake Controls
guardrails.description: The shell links to local docs or generated local pages; it does not expose disabled-looking controls that imply live integrations.

guardrails.title: No External Actions
guardrails.description: No GitHub API, SSH, deployment, release, model-provider, benchmark, or dataset action is performed from this shell.

guardrails.title: Blocked State Visible
guardrails.description: Repository hygiene, public readiness, release readiness, and live integrations remain visibly blocked until evidence changes.

guardrails.title: Evidence First
guardrails.description: Active or completed states must link to current evidence records or stay planned/blocked.
